card_en: To say there is no, or no more, of something, use ni or ni več with the noun in the genitive: ni kruha, ni več vode. Nimam and nimamo take the genitive too: nimam denarja.

quick_check.explain_en: After ni, kava takes the genitive: ni več kave.

helper_de: German says es gibt kein Brot mehr. Slovenian has no word for kein here: ni več kruha, with kruh in the genitive.
helper_en: English says there is no bread. Slovenian uses ni, the not of je, and changes the noun: ni kruha.
